description.value: Frick & Frack Tap House is a long-established casual dining spot in central Kamloops that has been welcoming guests since 1996. It offers an eclectic menu drawing on international influences — from Swiss schnitzel to Greek-style lamb — alongside an extensive selection of craft beers on tap and wines from around the world. The laid-back, family-friendly atmosphere and full catering service make it a natural gathering point for cycling groups finishing a ride through the heart of BC's interior.
